_comment: St. Paul ArcGIS FeatureServer dataset configuration. These endpoints are hardcoded in pipeline/core/load.py and fetch automatically. No configuration needed - just keep CENSUS_API_KEY in .env or GitHub Actions secrets.

crime.title: Crime Incident Report
crime.description: Police-reported crime incidents (major incidents only) in St. Paul

permits.title: Approved Building Permits
permits.description: Approved building/development permits in St. Paul with coordinates and district assignment

requests.title: Resident Service Requests
requests.description: Resident-reported infrastructure and service issues (311-style requests) with coordinates

housing.title: Housing Production
housing.description: New housing units produced (all unit types) with coordinates for spatial joining

notes: ✅ Fetches directly from St. Paul ArcGIS services
✅ Falls back to local CSVs if APIs unavailable
ℹ️ Only requirement: CENSUS_API_KEY (free from census.gov)
ℹ️ If updating: check https://services1.arcgis.com/9meaaHE3uiba0zr8/arcgis/rest/services for new service names
